name: yangble5
description: A plausible-looking model-pool config in a popular OSS LLM proxy silently destroys prompt caching. yangble5 is the corrected config, a Claude-wire shim, and the benchmark that proves it: 99.53% token-weighted cache hit on warm rounds (cold round 0%), a 748,918-token prompt. One machine, one run, 2026-07-21. Not a model. Built on CLIProxyAPI.
